paper.title_en: Shadows and Images of Black Holes with Purely Nonlinear Scalarization
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the shadows and radiative images of static, spherically symmetric black holes with purely nonlinear scalarization in Einstein--scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity. The quartic exponential coupling supports scalarized backgrounds without a linear tachyonic instability of Schwarzschild black holes. We compare mass and coupling dependences and construct images on radially stable backgrounds using optically thin spherical emission and face-on thin disks. On the sampled radially stable branches, we find smaller shadow radii than those of Schwarzschild black holes at the same mass, with reductions reaching approximately $21.7\%$. The sampled radially unstable branches show much smaller shadow-size deviations. The photon-orbit index, which measures radial instability per unit orbital angle, varies nonmonotonically even when the normalized shadow radius changes monotonically. The index also controls the asymptotic compression of higher-order images, providing information complementary to shadow size. For spherical emission, radial infall produces a darker center relative to the bright ring than static emission. For circular disks, we find that smooth metric variations can create an unstable interval separating two stable regions of timelike circular motion. When the disk occupies the stable region connected to infinity, its inner edge moves outward across this transition, suppressing emission inside the geometric shadow boundary while the normalized shadow radius changes only slightly. Our results show that purely nonlinear scalarization can alter images through both photon propagation and the orbital structure of emitting matter, with the visible features depending on the emission model.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究爱因斯坦-标量-高斯-邦内引力中纯非线性标量化黑洞的阴影与辐射图像，属于修改引力主题，并涉及光子传播与轨道结构等基础问题；理论建模较为深入，方法描述具体，给出定量结果（阴影半径减小约21.7%），因此值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 具有纯非线性标量化的黑洞阴影与图像
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了爱因斯坦-标量-高斯-邦内引力中具有纯非线性标量化的静态球对称黑洞的阴影与辐射图像。四次指数耦合支持标量化背景，而无需施瓦西黑洞的线性快子不稳定性。我们比较了质量和耦合的依赖关系，并利用光学薄球体发射和正面薄盘在径向稳定背景上构造了图像。在采样的径向稳定分支上，我们发现阴影半径小于相同质量施瓦西黑洞的阴影半径，减小幅度可达约$21.7\%$。采样的径向不稳定分支显示阴影尺寸偏差小得多。光子轨道指数衡量单位轨道角度的径向不稳定性，即使归一化阴影半径单调变化，该指数也非单调变化。该指数还控制高阶图像的渐近压缩，提供补充阴影尺寸的信息。对于球体发射，与静态发射相比，径向内落产生相对于亮环更暗的中心。对于圆盘，我们发现平滑的度规变化可以产生一个不稳定区间，将两个稳定的类时圆轨道区域分开。当盘占据与无穷远相连的稳定区域时，其内边缘在此转变过程中向外移动，抑制几何阴影边界内部的发射，而归一化阴影半径仅略有变化。我们的结果表明，纯非线性标量化可以通过光子传播和发射物质的轨道结构改变图像，可见特征依赖于发射模型。
